sources.title: Electronic Visa
sources.publisher: Ministry of Hotels and Tourism, Myanmar
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Ministry of Hotels and Tourism page identifies the official Ministry in its header and publishes an expressly numbered 100-country list under an ordinary-passport Tourist Visa heading. Ethiopia is named at number 29.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Ordinary passport holders from the following countries ... are eligible to apply Tourist Visa.

sources.title: Myanmar eVisa Frequently Asked Questions
sources.publisher: Ministry of Immigration and Population, Myanmar
sources.officialityEvidence: The live JSON is served by the official Myanmar eVisa host on moip.gov.mm. It describes approval-letter email delivery and expressly places visa issuance and stamping at the Immigration Arrival counter.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Your visa will be issued and stamped inside your passport at the Myanmar Immigration Arrival counter.

sources.title: Myanmar eVisa Frequently Asked Questions: product label
sources.publisher: Ministry of Immigration and Population, Myanmar
sources.officialityEvidence: The same live official FAQ calls the pretravel product eVisa and says applicants proceed to Immigration on arrival. This branding is preserved as a conflict note, while the project issuance-point taxonomy follows the FAQ's separate statement that the visa is issued and stamped at arrival.
sources.supportingExcerpt: eVisa is not a Visa on Arrival; therefore, there is no need to queue for a visa sticker.

sources.title: On-Arrival Visa Information
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Ministry page separately names the direct airport tourist-VOA cohort and conditions. It lists no residual passport and does not create a complement.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Passport holder from the following countries are eligible to apply Visa On Arrival for Tourist Visa.

sources.title: List of Countries Having Bilateral Visa Exemption Agreements with Myanmar
sources.officialityEvidence: The official Ministry PDF is dated 27 January 2026 and uses separate ordinary, diplomatic and official columns. It is a positive schedule, not a non-listed-passport rule.
sources.supportingExcerpt: List of Countries Having Bilateral Visa Exemption Agreements with Myanmar (As of 27 January 2026).

sources.title: Tourist Visa
sources.publisher: Embassy of the Republic of the Union of Myanmar, Tokyo
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Embassy page describes a tourist-visa application and confirmation procedure. It does not name nationalities, establish accreditation/residence coverage, or make a universal ordinary-passport route.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Visa applicants are requested to submit visa fees ... only after receiving visa confirmation from the Embassy.

policies.title: Ethiopian ordinary passports: Myanmar pre-authorised tourist visa issued at arrival
policies.summary: Myanmar's current tourism-ministry schedule expressly names Ethiopia in its ordinary-passport Tourist Visa cohort. The current immigration FAQ requires pretravel electronic application and approval but states that the visa is issued and stamped at the Immigration Arrival counter. Under the project issuance-point taxonomy, this is visa_on_arrival rather than evisa.
conditions: Ordinary Ethiopian passport only; travel documents are not accepted.
Tourist purpose, one entry and a 28-day stay from arrival.
Apply and pay online before travel; approval-letter validity is 90 days from issue and processing is at least three Myanmar working days.
Passport must be valid at least six months; return-ticket and accommodation evidence are required.
Present the approval letter at arrival. The MOIP FAQ says the visa is issued and stamped at the Myanmar Immigration Arrival counter.
Use only Yangon, Mandalay, Nay Pyi Taw international airports or Kawthaung International Land Border Checkpoint; cruise/seaport uses a separate arranged-VOA route.

The FAQ calls the product eVisa and says not to queue at a visa-sticker desk. This wording conflicts with its express frontier issuance statement; status follows the project's issuance-point taxonomy.

application.label: Official Myanmar eVisa tourist application
application.processingTime: At least three Myanmar working days after submitted and paid application.
steps: Submit and pay the tourist application before travel with the required passport, return-ticket and accommodation evidence.
Receive and print the approval letter.
Travel only through an authorised eVisa entry point and present the approval letter at the Immigration Arrival counter for visa issuance and stamping.

conflicts.explanation: The live Ministry of Hotels and Tourism ordinary-passport schedule expressly names Ethiopia. MOIP's FAQ makes the electronically delivered approval letter pre-authorisation and says the visa is issued and stamped at the Immigration Arrival counter.
